notes.title: 【追加シナリオ実装】アップデート ver2.00
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for enjoying [i]Inverted Angel[/i].[/p][p]Sorry for the delay in releasing the English version.[/p][p]For now, this update is only available in Japanese ver.[/p][p][/p][p]Today we have released the [b]ver.2.00 update[/b]. The changes are as follows:[/p][p][/p][h3]New Scenario[/h3][p]We have implemented the continuation of the scenario that previously displayed the message [i]“Currently, this causality has no continuation.”[/i][/p][p]This scenario becomes available after clearing the main story achievement [i]“Inverted Angel”[/i].
It’s a relatively light addition, but we hope you will enjoy it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Please Note[/b][/p][p]Save data from previous versions cannot branch into or access the new scenario.[/p][p]To experience the new scenario, please start from [b]“New Game.”[/b][/p][p]*Progress in scenarios from earlier versions is unaffected and will work fine with your existing save data.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Illustrations & UI[/h3][p]We’ve added new backgrounds and UI designed by illustrator [b]a37[/b].
Some of the existing UI elements and backgrounds have also been updated.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Text adjustments in existing scenarios[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to scenario progression logic[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Special Sale[/h3][p]To celebrate the update, both the main game and the soundtrack will be on sale until [b]September 16, 19:00 (JST)[/b].
Don’t miss this chance to grab them![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you continue to enjoy [i]Inverted Angel[/i].[/p]

notes.title: Update ver1.15
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying “Inverted Angel.”
Today, we have updated the game to version 1.15.

8/9のver1.14で、一度取得したSteam実績がリセットされてしまうバグが発生しました。
そのバグに対応するために、急遽ゲーム内にエンディングリストを実装しました。

In version 1.14 released on 8/9(JST), a bug of resetting Steam achievements occurred.
To resolve this issue, we implemented an Ending List feature in the game.

[list]
[*]Your game progress is saved separately as save data, independent of Steam achievements.
[*]If your Steam achievements have been reset, you can restore them by tapping the icon of each unlocked ending in the Ending List.
[*]The Ending List can be accessed from the title screen menu.
[/list]

We have taken measures to prevent the reset of Steam achievements as much as possible in version 1.15, if the issue reoccurs, we apologize for the inconvenience and would appreciate it if you could report it on the forums.
*Please note that even if Steam achievements are reset, as described above, it will not affect your game progress, and you can restore them from the Ending List.

[u]The English version is scheduled for release in autumn 2024.[/u]
We hope you continue to enjoy “Inverted Angel.”

notes.title: Update ver1.12
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying “Inverted Angel.”
Today, we have updated the game to version 1.12.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added save functionality in the input section of the first half of the story (before branching story).
[*]Increased the number of backlog entries and disabled screen effects in the log.
[*]Increased the number of save data slots.
[*]Fixed a bug with achievements on the Mac version (I plan to add a feature to retroactively acquire achievements that should have already been obtained).
[*]Corrected some text (some typos and additional search results).
[/list]
* Please note that Steam achievements and in-game route completion history are managed separately, therefore Steam achievement status will not affect gameplay progress.

[b]Planned future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Feature to retroactively acquire achievements that should have already been obtained on the Mac version.
[*]Addition of an ending list.
[*]Improved save data slot management functions.

We hope you continue to enjoy “Inverted Angel.”
